mechanisms.what: one well-mixed compartment of units with 2-4 states (content = state index); reversible two-unit rules; energy change = single-unit energies minus reservoir work at the first boundary participant; rates kappa*exp(-dE/2) times ordered pairs
pages, unit counts, state counts, energies and rules: found by selection on survival in fresh chemotaxis ring worlds each generation (validation seeds 500-515), inside the life gate; not designed
unified interface fixed in the prereg: F receptors mu = ln c; one motor unit, tumble when in a state >= 1; E store mu = 6 + ln(reserve/150); D waste mu = -6
